pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/content/models/AssetInventory/useAssetInventory.ts:45 The inventory is a filesystem scan of the UE project reconciled against the bridge manifest; a case-insensitive grep of src/components/modules/content/models for candidate, licen, acquir, genHistory and credit found no hits (its only 'provenance' is declared-vs-inferred dependency edges), so no generative slot, candidate selection or paid generation exists here to gate.

pairs.subject: generative-artifact-gating
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/content/audio/SoundForgePanel.tsx:103 The Sound Forge dispatches one billed /api/audio-gen POST per take in a plain loop with no reservation taken under a cross-process lock, no per-slot attempt cap across runs, no proof take before the batch and no durable stop latch, and the server route and meter both state the quota is never consulted, so a quota or rate-limit error only aborts the current loop and nothing refuses the next run.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/content/audio/SoundForgePanel.tsx:103 Each take is dispatched directly; no reserve-then-dispatch ledger, no per-slot cap across revisions (only MAX_VARIATIONS_PER_RUN per run), no latch set on first quota evidence.

src/components/modules/content/audio/SoundForgePanel.tsx:132 Library sets here are filled only by provider generation; the provider licence is shown undeclared rather than defaulted, but no acquired/downloaded asset shares these slots.

pairs.subject: generative-artifact-gating
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/steps/GenerativeStepFrame.tsx:69 The gallery steps grade the selected candidate correctly and defer stand-ins, but a candidate's origin is never recorded as a first-class value at creation: realness is inferred from the file's location and filename rule, from imageUrl presence and from swatch shape, and any on-disk asset path counts as generated with no acquisition/licence branch even though library assets are fed into the same produce.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/steps/itemsSteps.ts:507 gradeGallerySelection resolves the selection against kept batches, fails on unresolved or back-reference-mismatched selections, and names the asset in the pass detail.
src/lib/catalog/acceptance/galleryArtifact.ts:50 Stubs are deterministic, same-shape and self-describing in the data; no history or a swatch-only selection grades deferred at L4, never pass.

src/components/layout-lab/steps/GenerativeStepFrame.tsx:107 Tri-state+none provenance (auto/human/unrecorded) lives in genHistory, is never back-filled, new batches reset to auto, and the marker is shown on the step; acceptance does not fail on it.

src/lib/catalog/acceptance/galleryArtifact.ts:111 GenCandidate has no origin field; origin is read off representation shape (url( vs gradient, imageUrl presence), and pruneHistory deletes old batches rather than marking them discarded (genHistory.ts:185).

src/lib/catalog/acceptance/galleryArtifact.ts:101 Any populated asset path is graded as a generated pass; there is no acquisition-record branch, yet ArchetypeStep.tsx:434 passes library (downloaded) assets into the same produce.
